systems.name: 1.1 Map Format Support
systems.notes: Ensure BUILD2UDMF correctly parses all Witchaven 1, Witchaven 2, and TekWar .MAP files (Build v6/v7). Handle any custom lump offsets or encryption if present.
tasks: Test conversion of every Witchaven 1 single-player map
Test conversion of every Witchaven 2 map
Test conversion of all TekWar maps (shareware + registered)
Verify sector/wall counts match original level data

systems.name: 1.2 Blood vs Plain Build Detection
systems.notes: BUILD2UDMF already handles Blood's BLD header and dbCrypt. Ensure no false positives for Witchaven/TekWar maps. They are plain Build, so Blood path must be bypassed.
tasks: Add explicit detection for Blood header (BLD+) vs plain Build
Guard against dbCrypt on non-Blood files
Test with Witchaven maps to confirm plain path

systems.name: 1.3 UDMF Output Validation
systems.notes: Validate generated UDMF against GZDoom's parser. Ensure all sector/linedef/thing properties are correctly mapped. No missing required fields.
tasks: Load sample UDMF in GZDoom and check for errors
Compare in-game visuals with original Build map screenshots
Fix any misaligned geometry or missing textures
